labelClasses.cls: C1c 'Played for both X and Y' routed as one club
labels: Played for both AC Milan and Inter
Played for both Manchester United and Manchester City
Played for both Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid
labelClasses.currentBehaviour: '^played for' captures 'both X and Y' as a single club name, and a stored club counts if its folded name is a substring of that phrase. What each label actually accepts: (1) AC Milan/Inter accepts any 'AC Milan' player. 'Inter Milan' does not match because the phrase ends with 'inter', so Inter-only players are refused and AC Milan-only players are confirmed. (2) Man United/Man City accepts Manchester City (170), Manchester United (158) or Chester City (5). (3) Real/Atlético accepts Real Madrid (168) or the lone 'Atlético Madrid' string. 'Atlético de Madrid' does not match. All three labels sit on the same hard board.

labelClasses.cls: C1e every club refusal: careerComplete is unsound because the stints table is a top-500 sample, not a career
labelClasses.currentBehaviour: YES comes from a substring club match. A missing club becomes a hard, cached NO whenever the fetched rows carry one nationality and (debut_year >= 2005 or debut_age <= 21). That covers 23,321 of the 27,803 names. The same NO path applies to C1a-C1d. Boards for these 74 labels: easy 462, normal 98, hard 6. All 105 club-routed labels together fill 1,888 slots.
labelClasses.wrongVerdictEvidence: The stints table is derived from player_market_values, capped at rank 500 per position per year: max(rank) is 500 in every year, and 2004 has 5,592 player-years in both tables. Four holes follow from that. (1) Positions drop out. 'Defensive Midfield' has 432 player-years in 2022 and 0 in 2023-2026; 'Left Midfield' has 3 in 2021-2022. 412 DM-coded names end in 2022 but are treated as complete: Casemiro ends Real Madrid 2022, Aurélien Tchouaméni ends AS Monaco 2022, Moisés Caicedo ends Brighton 2022, Martín Zubimendi ends Real Sociedad 2022, Joshua Kimmich ends 2022, Kalvin Phillips ends Leeds 2022 (Man City missing), Denis Zakaria ends Gladbach 2022 (Juventus, Chelsea, Monaco missing), João Palhinha ends Sporting 2022 (Fulham missing). So 'Tchouaméni x Played for Real Madrid' and 'Casemiro x Played for Manchester United' are hard NOs. (2) The 2004 floor. debut_year is clamped to 2004, and 1,227 names that start at 2004 aged 21 or under count as complete. Cached: 'cristiano ronaldo|played for sporting cp|played in premier league' is a data NO (Sporting 2002-03 predates the table). Kaká (AC Milan 2004, debut age 21) would be refused for São Paulo. (3) Stale tails. 173 of the 894 2026 World Cup squad players found in stints end before 2025 and are treated as complete. Cached: 'calhanoglu|played for inter milan' is a data NO, yet stints end at AC Milan 2021 while world_cup_players 2026 lists his club as 'Inter Milan'. (4) Yearly snapshots drop half seasons: Enzo Fernández has River Plate 2022 and Chelsea 2023, and his Benfica spell is missing. Namesake refusals are cached too: 'romario|played for barcelona' (stints 'romario' is a Brazilian left-back at Avaí, Ceará and Goianiense 2015-18; world_cup_players 1994 puts Romário at Barcelona) and 'mariano|played for real madrid' (stints 'mariano' is a Brazilian right-back 2008-20).
labelClasses.dataThatCanSettle: YES: soccer_player_club_stints with canonical club identity and a real identity guard. Round 489's nationality guard misses same-nationality namesakes: 'koke' merges two Spanish players, and 'rodri' merges a 2006-12 centre-back with the Man City midfielder. NO: no table in the database holds complete careers. soccer_player_career_paths has 587 rows and soccer_player_careers_expanded 175. A club NO cannot be settled honestly, so it should return unverified (no guess charged) until a complete career source is imported. A partial cross-check is available: world_cup_players.club (2006-2026) disagrees with stints for 12.7-23.5 percent of complete-flagged squad players per tournament. That is an upper bound, because part of the gap is alias misses.

Right-Back' family) would be refused on 'Full-back or wing-back'. Zlatan Ibrahimović (in stints, Sweden) would now be refused on 'Scored in the Milan derby'. labelClasses.dataThatCanSettle: Per label. 100 caps (2 labels): world_cup_players.caps is the pre-tournament count, non-null on all 9,427 rows, 218 players at 100 or more. That gives YES only. NO is not honest, because a player can pass 100 after his last World Cup or never play one, and soccer_player_facts and soccer_player_careers_expanded have 0 non-null international_caps. Retire, or YES plus unverified. Named African Player of the Year: soccer_awards 'African Footballer of the Year' has 70 rows and 54 years, 1970-2025 (2020-21 not awarded, 39 winners). YES and NO are possible after fixing a column shift: winner_name holds '1st' and the name sits in the nationality column. Full-back or wing-back: stints.position Left-Back or Right-Back gives YES; NO as for positions (C8). African player, Asian player, CONCACAF: stints.nationality plus a confederation map that is not in the database (CAF 52 strings/2,763 names, AFC 37/1,280, CONCACAF 29/1,421). 'Asian' is ambiguous for Australia's 104 names. Messi teammate: stints (Messi rows 2004-2026: Barcelona, PSG, Inter Miami) give YES on a same-club, same-year overlap; NO is not honest because of truncation. Captained their national team: national_team_squads.is_captain has 102 rows, World Cups 2018-2026 only, so YES only; retire. Played under (5), became a PL manager, cost or fee (2), three or more countries, PL/national-team goal thresholds and derby or Clasico goals: no soccer manager, real transfer-fee, club-country or goal-event table exists. bootroom_transfer_log is a simulation; world_cup_players.goals is 0 for Messi 2006-2014. Retire.

labelClasses.cls: C5 league label: AI only for YES (the records pass returns unknown)
labels: Played in a World Cup knockout game
labelClasses.currentBehaviour: '^played in' routes to league, and evaluate() returns 'unknown' for it. A YES is only possible through Gemini. A NO comes from the data pass only when the paired criterion refutes; otherwise it goes to the AI, or to unverified or exhausted when the allowance is spent. This class is why easy boards depend on the AI: 441 of the 474 slots are on easy boards (344 easy boards, 23 normal, 5 hard). The easy tier has 31.3 percent AI cells, and only 12 of the 46 daily easy boards from 08-01 to 09-15 had none. 'Played in a World Cup knockout game' is caught by the same regex.
labelClasses.wrongVerdictEvidence: No wrong data verdict is possible, because the pass never decides this label. Cached AI verdicts on these labels are few: 'david beckham|played for real madrid|played in mls' is valid. The cost is availability, not correctness.
labelClasses.dataThatCanSettle: Nothing in the database maps club x season to league. player_market_values, bootroom_club_season and rebuild_clubs have no league column. soccer_club_puzzles gives one current league for only 304 of the 4,931 stint club strings, with no season history. soccer_league_champions holds only champions and runners-up. Honest YES needs an imported club-season-league table joined to stints years. An interim YES could use clubs present in every season from 2004 to 2026: Arsenal FC, Chelsea FC, Everton FC, Liverpool FC, Manchester City, Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur cover 1,144 names for the Premier League. NO is never honest from stints (truncation, see C1e), so it should be unverified. MLS is a closed league, and soccer_club_puzzles lists 29 MLS clubs, so YES would come via club identity. For 'World Cup knockout game' no lineup data exists (world_cup_matches.round is NULL on all 684 rows; world_cup_player_stats has 0 rows), so retire it. Retiring every league label would gut the easy tier, so either import the table or regenerate the boards.

labelClasses.dataThatCanSettle: Ballon d'Or (8 boards): ballon_dor (award_type 'Men', rank 1, 69 winners 1956-2025, 2020 not awarded) supports YES and NO once identity handles 'Ronaldo' (2002) versus Cristiano. World Cup Winner / Won the World Cup (11 boards): world_cup_players winner squads for 1970-2026 give YES; NO is honest for players whose era is after 1966 (all stints names, or a world_cup_players DOB after about 1950), since 1930-1966 squads are absent. Lost a World Cup final: runner-up squads are in world_cup_players, but runner-up nations are not in any table (soccer_league_champions.runner_up for 'World Cup' holds scores), so it needs a 15-row list like WC_WINNER_BY_YEAR. Captained a winning team: is_captain exists only for 2018-2026, so retire. World Cup final goals, red cards, penalties and scoring at two tournaments: no event data, so retire. Golden Boot: ambiguous label, and the sources are dirty (individual_awards_v2 European Golden Shoe has duplicate and junk rows like '2020, 21, 2021, 22'; soccer_awards World Cup Golden Boot rows include 'Castrol Football', 'Spain', '1'), so retire or relabel and clean. Every club or national trophy (CL, Europa, Libertadores, Euro, Copa, AFCON, league titles, FA Cup, domestic cups, major trophy): soccer_continental_finals, soccer_league_champions, soccer_domestic_cup_finals and trophy_winners name only the winning club or nation, with no squads, and stints are yearly top-500 snapshots, not squads. Nothing settles these per player, so retire or import winners' squads. Puskás, Golden Boy, PFA: not in any table (Premier League Player of the Season is a different award), so retire.

labelClasses.cls: C7 'YYYY World Cup Winner': data settles both ways, but name matching and person identity are wrong
labelClasses.currentBehaviour: checkWorldCupWinner reads the complete winning squad from world_cup_players (22-26 rows) and accepts if the folded squad name equals the guess, contains it, or is contained by it; the first such row wins. It refuses otherwise, with a hard cached NO. A paired position is settled from the squad row only when stints are empty; otherwise the paired position or club comes from whoever stints resolves the typed name to. Boards: normal 161, hard 25. This is why the normal tier needs almost no AI: 9.5 percent AI cells, and 46 of 46 daily normal boards from 08-01 to 09-15 had none.
labelClasses.wrongVerdictEvidence: (1) A typed full name containing a squad mononym is confirmed. Cached: 'cristiano ronaldo|1994 world cup winner|forward (fwd)' (hit 'Ronaldo') and 'thomas muller|1994 world cup winner|forward (fwd)' (hit 'Müller'); neither is in the round-613 purge SQL, whose H branch excludes multi-word input. The node probe shows the same rule would confirm Vinícius Júnior for 2002 ('Júnior'), Rafael Leão and Eduardo Camavinga for 1970 ('Leão', 'Edu'), Marcos Alonso for 2002 ('Marcos') and Pedro Neto for 2010 ('Pedro'). The 1970, 1994 and 2002 squads have 17, 16 and 16 mononyms. (2) Fragments are confirmed. Cached: 'ram|2010...' gives Sergio Ramos, 'pirl|2006...' Andrea Pirlo, 'stefa|1990...' Stefan Reuter. (3) The paired criterion is judged on another person. Cached: 'romario|1994 world cup winner|defender (def)' is valid, but stints 'romario' is a Brazilian Left-Back (Avaí, Ceará, Goianiense 2015-18) while the 1994 squad row is 'Romário FW'. 'ruggeri|1986...|defender' has fullName 'Matteo Ruggeri' against squad 'Oscar Ruggeri'; 'frank|1990...|forward' has fullName 'Nikolas Frank' against 'Frank Mill'. (4) Real spellings are refused. Squad rows 'Steven Nzonzi' and 'Alexis Mac Allister' cannot be reached by 'N'Zonzi' or 'Steven N'Zonzi' ('n zonzi') or by 'McAllister'. Cached refusals include 'n‘zonzi|2018' and 'mcallister|2022'. Typos ('tafarel', 'ronaldino', 'lillian thuram', 'jairzinio') are refused even though the AI prompt promises leniency.
labelClasses.dataThatCanSettle: YES and NO: world_cup_players, winner squads for the 11 labelled years (about 250 rows, with position, club and DOB non-null). Match on an exact folded name, an exact token set, or a space-insensitive compare; never on raw substring. Take the paired position from the squad row (world_cup_players.position), or require the stints identity to be the same man (club or DOB agreement), before confirming.
